integrity.claim_basis: Self-contained case proof with finite adjacency-based corroboration from verify.py and verification_output.txt.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns two complete-graph factors each of order at least four; it counts named optimum Roman labelings, not automorphism orbits.
The numerical Roman domination number of six is previously known; the new claim is its optimizer classification and enumeration.
An equivalent enumeration in unindexed literature cannot be excluded.
title: Optimal Roman labelings of direct products of two complete graphs
